dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Looking like this... you have something to ask of me, don't you?
dialogues.text_zh: 看妳這樣子……是有求於我，對吧？

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: ... Yes, I want to borrow your power.
dialogues.text_zh: ……嗯，我想要借用您的力量。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: To protect oneself in Happy Town... just Hansel and I are not enough.
dialogues.text_zh: 想要在歡樂鎮中保護自己……只靠我和韓賽兒的力量不夠。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: ... No matter what, I want to stay in my hometown and sell desserts to everyone I care about!
dialogues.text_zh: ……無論如何，我都想繼續待在自己家鄉，把甜點販售給我在乎的大家！

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: I will use anything to achieve my goal!
dialogues.text_zh: 為了達到目的，我什麼都可以利用！

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: If it's you... you should be able to recover the building and rebuild a defense boundary, right?
dialogues.text_zh: 如果是您的話……應該能夠建構復原以及防禦的結界吧？

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Well, let's see how sincere you are.
dialogues.text_zh: 呵，那就讓我看看妳的誠意吧。

dialogues.text: Looking at the stiff rod up close, Britney was a little nervous. The huge thing in front of her had a size and heavy sack that she has never seen before.
dialogues.text_zh: 近距離看著硬挺的肉棒，布蘭妮有些緊張，眼前的巨物有著她前所未見的尺寸與沉重的囊袋。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: ... how-how amazing... that such a thing can be hidden in the pants...?
dialogues.text_zh: ……真、真厲害啊……這樣的東西能藏在褲子裡面……？

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It's beating as if it has a life of its own...
dialogues.text_zh: 就像擁有自己生命一樣在跳動著……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It's not a snack... but...
dialogues.text_zh: 雖然不是點心……不過……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Since it is to be put into the mouth... first I should taste with the nose...
dialogues.text_zh: 既然是要放進嘴裡的……首先是從鼻腔品嚐味道……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: The musky taste exclusive to men...
dialogues.text_zh: 專屬於男人的麝香味……

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: You really are a dessert chef, you're so sophisticated.
dialogues.text_zh: 真不愧是甜點師，真講究啊。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: This is the secret to good dessert. First of all, you must have your own taste for food...
dialogues.text_zh: 這是甜點好吃的秘訣，首先自己必須擁有對美食的品味……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Mmm... the taste of meat rod...
dialogues.text_zh: 嗯……肉棒的味道……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: The savory aftertaste left on the tip of the tongue...
dialogues.text_zh: 在舌尖上殘留著的鹹味……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Amazing... mmm... really good...
dialogues.text_zh: 好厲害的味道…唔嗯……真的好棒……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It's better than I thought, I want more...
dialogues.text_zh: 比想像中的好吃，還想吃更多……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: (It's so big... I have to open my mouth so hard...)
dialogues.text_zh: （好大……要好努力地張大嘴巴……）

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: I'm digging in...!
dialogues.text_zh: 我要開動了……！

dialogues.text: Britney opened her mouth, a string of saliva between her parted lips, and slowly took in the rod.
dialogues.text_zh: 布蘭妮張開牽著一絲唾液的嘴，慢慢地含入肉棒。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Uhmm... it's so big...
dialogues.text_zh: 呼嗚……好大……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It's seeping in my mouth... mmm...
dialogues.text_zh: 在口腔內滲透出……嗯……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: The wet, hot, and salty fluid... mmm...
dialogues.text_zh: 濕濕的、又熱又鹹的液體……嗯……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Hah... mmm ahh... is that the right way... to taste...?
dialogues.text_zh: 哈……嗯啊……這樣品嘗的方式……對嗎？

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Yes, that's it... well done...
dialogues.text_zh: 對，就是這樣……做得很好……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: (It must be painful if I bite it. I have to be careful... it's so big...)
dialogues.text_zh: （咬到的話一定很痛吧？要小心一點……好大……）

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: (I can't help but indulge in this taste, it's like my obsession with desserts...)
dialogues.text_zh: （忍不住沉迷這樣的味道，彷彿對甜點的迷戀一樣……）

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: (Do peopleenjoy this every night...?)
dialogues.text_zh: （大家每天晚上都是享受著這樣的東西嗎……？）

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Look at you, all greedy... trying to make my rod feel good, you're a good girl.
dialogues.text_zh: 看妳貪婪的樣子……努力在讓肉棒舒服呢，真是乖孩子。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: I, um...
dialogues.text_zh: 我、嗯……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: I want to make the rod even more comfortable...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 想讓肉棒更加的舒服……♥

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Alright, I'd like to give Britney a rich reward for her efforts!
dialogues.text_zh: 好，給這樣努力的布蘭妮一個濃郁的獎賞吧！

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: It's your favorite whipped cream!
dialogues.text_zh: 是妳喜歡的鮮奶油喔！

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Please, please give me... the steamy hot whipped cream...!
dialogues.text_zh: 請、請給我……熱熱的鮮奶油……！

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Gurghh—!
dialogues.text_zh: 咕嗚嗚——！！

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Hah... hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: This is... Lord Archfiend's semen... mmm...
dialogues.text_zh: 這就是……魔王大人的精液……嗯……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It's like cream of the highest grade...
dialogues.text_zh: 就像是最高級的奶油一樣……

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It has a delicate flavor... and it melts very well...
dialogues.text_zh: 有著細緻的風味……化口性也很好……

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: It's a great honor to hear you say that.
dialogues.text_zh: 能讓妳這麼評價還真是榮幸。

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Although I'm asking you a favor, it doesn't seem like I'm paying for it...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 雖然有求於您，但感覺一點也不像是有付出代價的樣子……♥

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: It's no problem for me if I swallow it all, I want even more...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 就算全部吞下去也沒問題，還想要更多……♥

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Until not even a single drop is left ♥~
dialogues.text_zh: 一滴也不剩♥～

dialogues.speaker: Master
dialogues.text: Sex is supposed to be something that we can both feel happy about, isn't it?
dialogues.text_zh: 性愛本來就是彼此都能感到快樂的事情不是嗎？

dialogues.speaker: Ginger Britney
dialogues.text: Just like desserts... When you see the smile of the customer, the heart of the chef will also be filled with happiness...♥
dialogues.text_zh: 跟甜點一樣……看到客人的笑容，製作甜點的人心裡也會泛起幸福……♥
